args.question: How should invoice line items, taxes and postpaid data overage charges be explained, and how can future overage be reduced?

result:
{"status": "answered", "answer": "Applicable policy:
[POL-BIL-002 §1.2] Postpaid overage: Postpaid plans with a data cap charge $**.** per GB above the cap, billed on the invoice for that cycle.
[POL-BIL-002 §1.1] Line items: Explain each invoice line item in plain language: plan charge, overage, add-ons, and taxes (tax rate 8%).
[POL-BIL-002 §1.3] Prepaid usage: Prepaid plans are never charged overage; data speed is reduced after the cap is reached.

args.question: What retention offers may be made to a premium-tier postpaid customer with high churn risk and 48 months tenure who wants to cancel, what are the discount limits, and when is human approval required?

result:
{"status": "answered", "answer": "Applicable policy:
[POL-RET-001 §1.1] Tenure requirement: A monetary retention offer (discount, credit or plan upgrade) may only be made to a customer with a tenure of at least 6 months. Customers below this tenure may receive non-monetary offers only (OFF-DATA-BOOST).
[POL-RET-001 §1.2] Churn-risk requirement: Customers with churn_risk_label `high` may receive up to the full tier maximum in POL-RET-002 §1. Customers labelled `medium` may receive at most half of the tier maximum, rounded down to a whole percent. Customers labelled `low` may receive non-monetary offers only.
[POL-RET-001 §1.3] Explicit cancellation intent: When a customer explicitly states they intend to cancel, treat their churn risk as at least `medium` for the purpose of offer eligibility, even if the stored label is `low`.
